questions.question: A university wants to host its public-facing website on a public cloud but keep its sensitive student records database in an on-premises data center. Which cloud deployment model best describes this scenario?

An application developer wants to deploy a web application without managing the underlying operating system, web server software, or hardware infrastructure. Which cloud service model is most suitable?
Which cloud computing concept refers to the ability of a system to automatically scale its resources up or down dynamically based on real-time demand?
Under the cloud Shared Responsibility Model, which of the following is typically the sole responsibility of the customer?

options.A: Physical security of the data center facilities
options.B: Configuring security groups and firewall rules for cloud instances
options.C: Maintaining and patching the virtualization hypervisor
options.D: Disposal of decommissioned physical storage drives
